task.name: Strike_camp_sign
task.when: After 📋 Strike_camp_lighting passes and the Power Lead releases the sign

step.action: Confirm that 📋 Strike_camp_lighting passed and the Power Lead released the sign structure.
Remove each sign letter in the reverse printed order.
Lower and dismantle the sign support under the Build Lead's direction.
Bundle the support poles with 📦 Ratchet_Straps.
Put every fastener and anchor in the sign hardware bin.
Pack the letters and bundled poles in their assigned transport group.

passWhen.criterion: Every letter, pole, fastener, and anchor is accounted for and packed.
The former sign footprint is clear and MOOP-free.
